title: lint: warn when a package's `manifest.namespace` is longer than 13 characters, since it can then have no paired `<ns>_custom` customization namespace (ADR-0146, ruled on #28404)
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Filing gate: ① a follow-up the maintainer agreed with the #28404 ruling (「同意」, 2026-10-31 20:44Z, on the analysis in `/mnt/project-files/issue-28404/decision-analysis.md`, "对席位的落地备注" item 3). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it (the ruling calls it low priority).
Reader: the cli/lint lane (`packages/lint` authoring rules, surfaced by `os lint` / `os validate`); after PR #28467 lands, because the helper and the constant it reads ship there.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "namespace 13 characters lint" and "customization namespace warn" → no card about the pair namespace length (closest: #19831, closed, the namespace grammar's leading-digit sentence).
reach: author-time only: `os lint` / `os validate` on a stack whose `manifest.namespace` is 14 to 20 characters. Nothing in the repository is affected today: the longest base namespace is `feature_flags`, 13.

**Why.** ADR-0146 D3 gives a base package's paired customization package the namespace `<base_ns>_custom`. The manifest namespace grammar allows at most 20 characters, and `_custom` takes 7, so a base namespace over 13 characters gets no pair namespace. PR #28467 (#28404) answers that case with a named refusal from `customizationNamespace(baseNs)`: `{ ok: false, reason: 'base_namespace_too_long' }`, with no truncation and no hashing (maintainer ruling, point 1). The ensure door (N-13) will then refuse to create the pair. So installers of such a package can never customize it, and its author learns this only when a customer tries.

**Wanted.** An authoring rule that WARNs, not errors, when `manifest.namespace` is longer than `MAX_CUSTOMIZATION_BASE_NAMESPACE_LENGTH` (13). Suggested sentence: "namespace '<ns>' is N characters; a package's paired customization namespace is '<ns>_custom' and may be at most 20, so installers cannot customize this package. Shorten the namespace to 13 characters or fewer." Read the limit and the verdict from `customizationNamespace` / `MAX_CUSTOMIZATION_BASE_NAMESPACE_LENGTH` in `packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts`; restate neither. Add a rule id and an `os explain rule` entry, plus a test at 13 (silent) and 14 (warns) characters.

**Not here.** Changing the grammar's 20-character limit, or letting a pair choose another namespace. The ruling keeps both reversible for later.

Links back: #28404, PR #28467, epic #28236, ADR-0146 D3.

Blocked-by: #28467
